description: What counts as a route's weather getting worse from the briefing the pilot had (then) to a later one (now): a field's METAR in a worse flight category, and worse than VFR (AIM 7-1-7); a SIGMET, AIRMET or G-AIRMET newly on the route (AIM 7-1-6); a TAF where the flight lands forecasting a worse category, and worse than VFR, for the flight's time there. A caution, never a limit; each change keyed so an app tells it once.
